geometry_sampling: Balanced integer core radii; sampling without replacement from all valid integer shell-thickness combinations
material_sampling: All 400 valid material sequences, 75 samples per sequence
wavelength_grid_reason: Standard 400-1000 nm wavelength grid with geometry-level filtering of x=m*pi singular points
interpolation_method: linear interpolation of n and k, followed by epsilon=(n+i*k)^2
